greedy.text: Mr. Quilter is the apostle of the middle classes, and we are glad to welcome his gospel.  Nor is Mr. Quilter's manner less interesting than his matter.  He tells us that at this festive season of the year, with Christmas and roast beef looming  before us, similarly he's drawn from eating and its results occur most readily to the mind.  He has graved doubts whether Sir Frederick Layton's work is really Greek after all, and  can discover in it but little of Rocky Ithaca.  Lynelle's pictures are a sort of upgards and atom paintings, and Mason's exquisite  ittles are as national as a jingo poem.  Mr. Birk at Foster's landscapes smile at one much in the same way that Mr. Carker used  to flash his teeth.  And Mr. John Collier gives his sitter a cheerful slap on the back, before he says like a  a shampoo and a Turkish bath.  Next man.

He tells us that at this festive season of the year, with Christmas and roast beef looming  before us, similarly he's drawn from eating and its results occur most readily to the mind.  He has graved doubts whether Sir Frederick Layton's work is really Greek after all, and  and can discover in it but little of Rocky Ithaca.  Lynelle's pictures are a sort of up guards and atom paintings, and Mason's exquisite  ittles are as national as a jingo poem.  Mr. Birk at Foster's landscapes smile at one much in the same way that Mr. Carker used  to flash his teeth.  And Mr. John Collier gives his sitter a cheerful slap on the back, before he says, like  a shampooer and a Turkish bath. Next man!

aggregation: logMel is the long clip's input to every window, (80, frames), frames of 10 ms; a window reads frames seek … seek + 2,999, zero-padded past the end. languageP[k] is the softmax over the 99 language tokens of the first prediction after <|startoftranscript|>, for detections[k]'s 30 s window. greedy[w].steps[s].top is the distribution greedy chose from (softmax of the logits after Whisper's rules); rawP, timestampMass and maxOtherP are from the raw logits. beam[w].search[s].running are the five beams after step s: [parent beam at step s − 1, token, summed log-probability], best first; finished lists indices into `finished`, whose scores are the summed log-probability divided by the number of tokens written.
